answer: The delta chain is checked at intake, gaps appear in falcon, and whisper seals the repaired sequence, which the replay verifies against each signature. Cloning a key into 35 hands breaks the sequence as two signers race the same nonce, which means a shared-credential farm convicts itself on the first collision. Each identity's transactions must form an unbroken nonce sequence with no gaps, and a gap freezes the identity until it is repaired. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
